name: domain_intel
description: Passive and active domain intelligence: DNS records, WHOIS/RDAP registration, reverse DNS, IP geolocation and ASN ownership, subdomain enumeration through certificate-transparency logs, subdomain-takeover checks, technology fingerprinting from HTTP responses, SPF/DKIM/DMARC/CAA email-security records, passive-DNS and Wayback history, public bucket probing, and offline decoding of hashes, JWTs and packet captures. P0 passive is the default; anything that queries the target's DNS or contacts it is gated by core/tool_policy.py and names its target. Every result names its source, its key status, and its activity class.

operation.description: One of: dns | whois | reverse_dns | ip_geo | asn | subdomains | takeover_check | tech_fingerprint | passive_dns | wayback | bucket_probe | email_security | hash_identify | jwt_audit | pcap_analyze | apk_manifest | sources. Defaults to dns.

target.description: Alias for domain: a domain, IP, or URL depending on the operation.

ip.description: IP address for reverse_dns, ip_geo or asn.

record.description: DNS record type for the dns operation: A | AAAA | MX | TXT | NS | SOA | CAA | all. Defaults to all.

token.description: JWT to decode and audit (jwt_audit operation).

path.description: Path to a .pcap/.cap file for pcap_analyze, or an .apk for apk_manifest.

authorized.description: Must be true for operations that contact the target (tech_fingerprint, bucket_probe, email_security). Passive operations never need it.

confirm.description: Must be true to start an operation that contacts the target.

limit.description: Maximum items to return. Defaults to 20.

author: Stella
notes: Passive sources: crt.sh, CertSpotter, RDAP, RIPE/BGPView, ipapi, Wayback, Common Crawl, passive DNS. Active operations (fingerprint, bucket probe, DNS against the target) are gated and name their target.
